name: unreal-engine
description: Control a separately installed Unreal Editor through Epic Unreal MCP and adapted official skills. Requires UE with ModelContextProtocol and AllToolsets enabled.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过 Epic 官方 MCP 和 Skills 操作独立安装的 UE 编辑器。需启用 ModelContextProtocol 和 AllToolsets。
description_i18n.en: Control a separately installed Unreal Editor through Epic Unreal MCP and adapted official skills. Requires UE with ModelContextProtocol and AllToolsets enabled.

endpoint.description: Unreal MCP endpoint on the machine running the ZhangClaw agent. Keep the unauthenticated UE server on loopback.
